title: Make A Vital Times Origami Hen Friend
summary: Upcycle your latest issue of The Vital Times into a paper hen friend
body_markdown:
With a few simple folds, you can turn your latest issue of The Vital Times into a paper hen friend! Feeling extra crafty? Save future issues of The Vital Times and build yourself an entire flock!


**What you need:**


- 1 Vital Times newspaper
- Scissors
- Glue stick
- Colored Pencils


We’d love to see your creation! Tag us on social @vitalfarms.
